text:
elaine: T-minus 8m for class-api v2.3.1 rollout in us-west1. This is a staggered window across two lanes (stable -> canary1 -> canary2 -> global). Final owners: @sam (canary1), @josh (canary2), @kevin (stable). QA: @amy on smoke. Please ack and confirm rollback plan is ready.

samir note: I won't be available for the last two minutes but I did the preflight earlier. infra checks green.

amy: smoke test checklist done against staging mirrors, small prompt set passed. Load test script ran: ~1200rps per lane in canary config. No obvious tokenization regressions.

kevin: stable lane pre-warmed, autoscaler warm-up = 3 pods each. I verified that the dedicated cache is primed for the 0-prefix KB.

josh: canary2 ready. I updated the rollout strategy to 5% -> 25% after 10m if latency <= 120ms. I also bumped healthcheck threshold to 15s to avoid noisy restarts.

elaine: Good. Two quick asks before we kick: 1) Confirm feature-flag is off for the new routing (flag: classapi_v2_route). 2) Double-check rollback command works.

kevin: flag is OFF in prod. 

amy: rollback smoke validated in a dry-run, steps recorded in runbook.

josh: I tested the rollback command locally against a sandbox. Command we'll run if needed:

```
kubectl rollout undo deployment/class-api -n prod --to-revision=42
# or use infra toggle:
infra-cli routes set class-api --version=stable --env=prod
```

elaine: thanks. deploy-bot will do the canary increments and post status. Canaries are 2 minute steady-state checks each. If latency or error budget > 0.5% in a 2m window, auto-pause. Manual abort if owner reacts :no_entry_sign:.

deploy-bot: Automated canary plan scheduled. Performing preflight final checks now...

deploy-bot: Preflight ok — certs valid, image digest matches, rollout policy loaded. Starting canary1 (5%).

sam: canary1 up. Initial probe latency 98ms, errors 0.03%. Seeing expected traffic split.

elaine: hold for 2m to validate traces, logs, and slow-path metrics. Please post any anomalies here.

amy: quick smoke results: auth flows good, embeddings endpoint stable, no 500s. Noted slight P90 spike at 1.05s on one host but it's coming from a warmup artifact.

sam: canary1 steady. I'll proceed to canary2 in 1m.

deploy-bot: Scaling canary2 to 5%...

josh: canary2 up. Latency 110ms, errors 0.02%. Running a small model-regression eval now.

elaine: if the model-regression eval passes and QA thumbs up, we do 25% -> then full rollout after 15m stable. If anything looks off we hit rollback. Ready for final yes/no.

amy: regression eval passed on the checked prompts. No quality regressions detected. +1 from QA.

kevin: I'm ready to promote to 25%. I have pager open and a rollback window 30m.

sam: +1 from canary1. Logs clean.

josh: +1 from canary2. Proceed.

elaine: Rolling to 25% now — deploy-bot please increment and watch autoscaler.

deploy-bot: Increasing traffic to 25% over 30s. Monitoring: latency, error_rate, token_cost. Auto-pause thresholds enabled.

sam: 25% looks fine at 3m. No error regressions.

amy: smoke at 25% good. Small spike in tail latency on one AZ, but it's returning to baseline. I'll keep monitoring.

kevin: Stable lane: holding. Ready to cutover to 100% after the 15m soak if all good.

elaine: agreed. Everyone on deck for next 15m. If anybody needs to abort, call it now.

sam: all good from me.

josh: same.

amy: continuing monitor, nothing blocking.

elaine: final: rolling to 100% in 2m unless any objections.

kevin: go for it.

sam: go.

josh: go.

deploy-bot: Promoting to 100% over 1m. Will post completion message.

deploy-bot: Rollout complete. Post-rollout checks: latency baseline +4ms, error_rate +0.01%. All alerts within thresholds.

elaine: thanks team — closing the window. Please add any postmortem notes to the deploy runbook if you observed anything odd. :party_parrot:
